verdict.rationale: Trello is a kanban-style work management SaaS, not an AI coding agent, so restoring an agent session to a previous checkpoint does not apply to this kind of product. Its MCP server (connecting Trello to AI tools) and its AI writing helper are different capabilities. Neither shows that Trello runs or versions coding-agent sessions.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
